_comment: Log-to-file: when enabled, mirror every line written to process.stdout/process.stderr (including all log.info/warn/error output and any raw console.* calls) into the file at 'path'. ANSI color escape sequences are stripped from the file so it's grep-friendly; the terminal still shows colors. Path is relative to the project root unless absolute. The CLI flag '--log-file [path]' overrides 'enabled=true' and (when a path is supplied) 'path'. With neither a path here nor one after the flag, log-to-file stays off and says so. The file is opened in append mode so multiple runs accumulate; rotate or truncate it externally if it grows unbounded. Default disabled — opt in via the CLI flag for one-off diagnostic sessions, or set enabled=true here for a long-lived production tail. See docs/engineering.md 'Log-to-file' and the FAQ Troubleshooting entry for usage.
_errorLogPath_comment: Where catastrophic failures are recorded, for the operator to read after the fact: a scan that aborted before saving anything, for one. Always on, unlike the log above, and emptied at every startup, so it holds only the current run's failures. The dashboard's alert for such a failure names this file. Relative to the project root unless absolute. Read by src/error-log.js, which stops startup when it is not a file path.
